description: This file defines the class 'EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator', which implements menu configuration logic for the attendance module in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides module and screen settings for the viewAttendanceRecord screen.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class implements menu configuration for editing employee attendance records by overriding specific module and screen settings.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module to 'time' and screen to 'viewAttendanceRecord' within the provided Screen object.
